snippet.title: Death Howl | Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🧡Play demo now on Steam: https://re.11bits.com/vg0

Shape your decks and join Ro on her journey through the sorrowful spirit world to reunite with her son 🦌🃏 

#DeathHowl launches December 9th on Steam, with console releases coming in 2026.
